About Invesco 
 
 As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
 
 
 What’s in it for you? 
 

 Our people are at the ver y core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:   

 Flexible paid time off 

 Hybrid work schedule  

 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution  

 Health & wellbeing benefits  

 Parental Leave benefits  

 Employee stock purchase plan 

 

 
 
 Job Description 
 


 Overview 
 The ETF Quantitative Developer will play a key role in supporting the Equity ETF & Indexed Strategies platform through the design, development, and enhancement of portfolio management technology and analytics. This individual will partner closely with Portfolio Managers, Analysts, and Technology teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions that improve portfolio oversight, streamline workflows, and strengthen the team’s overall infrastructure.
 This role sits within a fast-paced, high-volume index portfolio management environment and requires both strong technical capabilities and a solid understanding of capital markets.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Partner with Portfolio Management, Research, Operations, and Technology to deliver data-driven insights, investment analytics, and portfolio reporting
 Design, develop, and maintain custom tools and applications to support ETF and indexed portfolio management
 Enhance existing portfolio oversight and monitoring frameworks, with a focus on scalability and efficiency
 Build and deploy quantitative models and analytics across internal and external portfolio management systems
 Automate and streamline daily workflows, reporting, and optimization processes
 Contribute to the evolution of the team’s data architecture and technology infrastructure
 Experience 
 0–3 years of experience in quantitative analytics, development, or a related role
 Exposure to the asset management or financial services industry is beneficial
 Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a team-oriented, high-volume environment
 Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field
 Strong programming capabilities, with experience in Python and/or R (additional languages such as C++ or Java are a plus)
 Experience working with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, Polars)
 Familiarity with data engineering and database environments, including Snowflake, is preferred
 Understanding of ETL pipeline development and data workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow)
 Exposure to cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS) and containerization (e.g., Docker) is beneficial
 Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
 Familiarity with portfolio management and analytics platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, Charles River, Axioma) is a plus
 Exposure to front-end development frameworks (e.g., Flask, Dash) is advantageous
 Core Competencies 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables with attention to detail
 Effective collaborator with strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation
 Work Environment 
 Full-time position based in Downers Grove, Illinois
 Collaborative, team-oriented environment aligned with the North American Equities platform
 The salary range for this position in Downers Grove, IL 110,000-138,500/year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location 
 
 Full Time / Part Time 
 
Full time 
 Worker Type 
 
Employee 
 Job Exempt (Yes / No) 
 
Yes 
 Workplace Model 
 
 Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development. 
 
 The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The job holder may be required to perform other duties as deemed appropriate by their manager from time to time. 
 
 Invesco's culture of inclusivity and its commitment to diversity in the workplace are demonstrated through our people practices. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, age, or veteran status. Our equal opportunity employment efforts comply with all applicable U.S. state and federal laws governing non-discrimination in employment.
